law: This sample code project shows how to use Core NFC in an app to read Near Field Communication (NFC) tags of types 1 through 5 that contains NFC Data Exchange Format (NDEF) data.
To use this sample, download the project and build it using Xcode.
Turn on Near Field Communication Tag Reading under the Capabilities tab for the project’s target (see ).

To avoid unintentional tag reading, the system reads tags in the background only when the user’s iPhone is in use.
Also, be aware there are times when the display is on and background tag reading is unavailable, such as if: The device has never been unlocked.
Apple Pay Wallet is in use.
The URI record must contain either a universal link or a supported URL scheme.
Use universal links instead.
